capabilities: Read projects and tasks from Markdown notes
View projects in a table and edit priority and status
Visualize task relationships on a canvas filtered by project
Connect tasks and track problems with alternative solutions
Add stable task IDs and edit task due dates
extras: Interface is in Chinese; mobile behavior is unverified in this release; relationships are stored in a separate graph.json data file rather than in notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to group tasks across notes into projects or track problems and alternative solutions tied to those tasks.
summary: Project manager that links Markdown tasks, projects and problems through stable task IDs and visualizes their relationships.
